scopeNotes: The provider-organization-documents full-suite failure was a shared browser navigation/font-readiness synchronization defect, not a product contract defect.
The repair uses DOMContentLoaded navigation plus awaited document.fonts.ready at screenshot boundaries; it does not add retries, sleeps, weakened assertions, or fake requests.

All 12 Public media findings are content_dynamic. Masks cover only variable image-pixel regions; container geometry, crop, aspect ratio, object-fit, overlays, labels, actions, and layout remain verified.
No Backend runtime, shared contract, API route, or Production behavior changed in this task.
The 108 snapshot files are enumerated in snapshot-review.json; error and success baselines remain separate.
knownGaps: The Web production build continues to emit the existing frontend_097 large-client-chunk warning (1,500.64 kB); this task did not worsen or claim to resolve it.
Optional scripts test:locale, test:performance, test:security, and test:uat are not defined in the current repository package scripts.
This evidence does not claim all APIs tested, all 131 screens complete, production parity, F7 completion, or full platform completion.
